description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D2y_periodic driven by problems/heat_2d_y_periodic.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NY is the open metaparameter (NX is edge-closed at 8; the solution is constant in x and no x-operator appears), and the problem's dy observed and inlined y coordinates use the NY name so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. The manufactured decaying solution exp(-alpha (2 pi)^2 t) cos(2 pi y) is exact for the continuous y-diffusion PDE (derivation in the problem file); cos(2 pi y_j) is an exact eigenvector of the discrete circulant periodic operator, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure O(dy^2) eigenvalue truncation from the dissipative operator.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried (loosest reltol 1e-6; all three solvers Erk/Bdf/Sdirk wedge). earthsci-toolkit-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so on this stiff / non-smooth-min-max / large-AST RHS it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
